rules.notes: "Futures | ₹20 or 0.03% per executed order (whichever is lower)." Read 2026-10-28 at https://fyers.in/charges-list (W-178; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md). Not modelled: Fyers' clearing charge on futures, "Clearing Charges ... 0.0005%" (W-186).

NSE equity futures transaction charge, 0.00173% (Rs 1.73 each side per lakh of traded value, NSE circular NSE/FA/64232 of 2024-09-27), from 1-10-2024 until 28-2-2026 (NSE/FA/73061). BSE differs; a card naming an exchange would outrank this one. docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md.
